reuse.why: Routes the five inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) through the existing exported getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing amounts.

duplication.why: Removes all duplicated range/missing-amount dispatches and leaves one definition of the rule.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, the module already owning schedule amount logic and used by both server and client.

scope.why: Only the rule, its call sites and tests change.

maintainability.why: Future changes to the expected-amount rule now touch a single, tested function.

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, now called by schedule-template.ts, forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts (two sites), computeSchedulePreviewTransactions and the existing client consumers.
